rci1_using_msad.detail: Pre-trained normative models (CentileBrain) developed by the ENIGMA Lifespan Group were applied; the reference cohort was not built within this study.
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: “Sex-specific normative models for each neuroimaging software (FreeSurfer)-derived regional CT, SA, and SV measure (eTable 6 in Supplement 1) were generated using a normative modeling framework for neuroimaging measures that belongs to the category of standard life charts (CentileBrain) 21 and was developed by the ENIGMA Lifespan Group.”
